label.zh: 官方承认一种视景，或两种都否定
label.en: Endorse one vision, or reject both

note.zh: 6040：选择“机械神”或“黑星”（两个选项都进入 6050 星界狂热，只是正文随选择的标记 accepted_mechanical_god_visions / accepted_black_star_visions 不同），或否定两者（→ 6045 后理论冲突，一名人口被杀，随后 → 6055 争论管制）。
note.en: 6040: endorse the “mechanical god” or the “black star” (both options lead to 6050 Astral Zeal, with different text depending on the carrier flag accepted_mechanical_god_visions / accepted_black_star_visions), or reject both (→ 6045 Post-Theoretical Conflict, one pop is killed, then → 6055 Debate Curtailed).

note.zh: 移除“星界奇观兴趣”与“冲突视景”修正；母国得凝聚力收入与国家修正 astral_zeal_modifier，此后每次完成裂隙探索，隐藏事件 6059 都再给一份凝聚力（on_astral_rift_exploration_complete，00_on_actions.txt:5017）。若是星界疤痕，则不再生成该疤痕上的异常。
note.en: The “Astralnomical interest” and “Conflicting visions” modifiers are removed; the owner gets a unity income and the country modifier astral_zeal_modifier, after which hidden event 6059 grants more unity each time a rift exploration completes (on_astral_rift_exploration_complete, 00_on_actions.txt:5017). For an astral scar the scar no longer generates an anomaly.

note.zh: 禁止公开讨论：移除兴趣修正，行星得“星界爱好者”修正（物理研究 +20%，裂隙探索速度 +20%），母国得凝聚力收入。
note.en: Public discussion is banned: the interest modifier is removed, the planet gets astral_aficionados_modifier (physics research +20%, rift exploration speed +20%) and the owner a unity income.

notes.zh: 起点：隐藏的行星事件 6029 在殖民地 3、4、5 岁时作为随机事件（权重 20，on_colony_3/4/5_years_old，00_on_actions.txt:3845/3865/3888）出现。条件：玩家（非 AI）的非首都、非母星、原始所有者的宜居殖民地，所在星系有星界裂隙或星界疤痕；帝国非格式塔 / 非机械 / 非唯物主义者，且尚未开始探索裂隙，也没经历过该事件。每个国家只会经历一次（rift 版本或疤痕版本）。之后每章间隔 180 天 + 随机 120 天。
notes.en: Start: the hidden planet event 6029 fires as a random event (weight 20) when a colony is 3, 4 or 5 years old (on_colony_3/4/5_years_old, 00_on_actions.txt:3845/3865/3888). Conditions: a player's (non-AI) non-capital, non-homeworld, originally-owned habitable colony in a system with an astral rift or astral scar; the empire is not gestalt / robot / materialist, has not started exploring rifts and has not had this event. It happens once per country (rift or scar version). Each chapter follows the previous by 180 days plus up to 120 random days.

notes.zh: 6040 的 after 块会随机给行星 6 种“分歧扩大”修正之一（稳定度 −5 至 −10），直到 6050/6055 把它们移除（脚本中 6050 只移除 conflicting_visions 与 astralnomical_interest_modifier）。
notes.en: The after block of 6040 randomly gives the planet one of six widening_divide modifiers (stability −5 to −10). In the script 6050 only removes conflicting_visions and astralnomical_interest_modifier, so whether the widening_divide modifier is cleared there was not found in these events.

scope.zh: 已核对 astral_planes.6029–6059、触发的 on_actions 与相关静态修正。
scope.en: Checked astral_planes.6029–6059, the triggering on_actions and the related static modifiers.

uncertain: 6050 / 6055 是否清除 widening_divide_N 修正在这些事件中没有看到。 / Whether 6050 / 6055 clear the widening_divide_N modifier is not visible in these events.
